notes.title: Bitmap Books - 50 Indie Games That Changed The World
notes.content:
[p]Bitmap Books recently released “50 Indie Games that Changed the World”, and featured [i]Guacamelee![/i] [/p][p]
“Each chapter represents the story of a particular indie game of note…all 50 are evidence of the impact and boundary-pushing capabilities only indie games can achieve” - Aaron Potter[/p][p][/p][p]This book is crafted with so much love and attention to detail, beautiful from cover to cover and inspiring in the stories it explores. We are truly humbled that [i]Guacamelee![/i] was included amongst so many genre-defining titles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6617403/ca5ce99f0a76815c7476a19fbd271f6eb08d6945.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Guacamelee![/i] will always hold a special place in our studio’s history, and its success is in no small part thanks to the love and enthusiasm of everyone that played and enjoyed it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6617403/3dc84c37da25eaaccca0187d707ca5ed74115336.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can find more information about this book (and get your own copy!) here: [/p][p][url="https://www.bitmapbooks.com/en-ca/products/50-indie-games-that-changed-the-world"]https://www.bitmapbooks.com/en-ca/products/50-indie-games-that-changed-the-world[/url][/p][p][/p][p]A big thanks to Bitmap Books for having us, and to you for supporting us.[/p][p]The Drinkbox Team[/p]

notes.title: Summer Development Update from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content: [p]Hey! How’s it going?  [/p][p]Eating well? Sleeping in? Folding clothes? [/p][p]That’s so great to hear.[/p][p][/p][p]- Oh, us? Nah, we haven’t been up to much. [/p][p]Well, except for all the work we’ve put into our new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/"][u]Blighted[/u][/url]. Check it out![/p][p][/p][p]As you know, we [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2974160/announcements/detail/533226373233248985"][u]announced[/u][/url] Blighted back in June as part of [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9JHPGemT0gI&ab_channel=thegameawards"][u]Summer Game Fest 2025[/u][/url], and we’ve been hard at work on it since. (Thanks for wishlisting it, by the way. It really does help 🙏)[/p][p][/p][p]We don’t want to spoil too much, buuuut we’ve added a TON of enemies to the game, and are still adding more! Each of them deadly in their own weird and freaky little way.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGirw8Xgso8NdeflBw5tE3v9twKbLroA8soxm1P_mNAdGmdkZ5C9_bJyPOj2GZDyuTPcmwgHdYx6G8IqpUKWSmOjzHdpvdjUPkOhc04Oza7_x-x0lJfhnmYhKJKRH3fZxsfhy88A?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]It’s hard to believe but we actually built out an early version of the entire game as part of an internal-alpha milestone! And right now we’re in the middle of tearing it all up, choosing the best bits, adding juicy challenges and putting it all back together again.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcB7WNc_ID7rJSXKc1JFCllZP1WG7931zeX0LzGzcbE39r41XNQEUhoFPC5fPW3r2ME0EwTgIr5yNacpA3YQVbiCgsbbN0d3VURjWpuC0UxvbzdqJl4Kz1GFr88HvST0So6Vln-3Q?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]Now, it might sound like we don’t have much left to do, but that couldn’t be further from the truth! We’re still fine tuning the gameplay and combat loop to go beyond the standard we’ve established in any of our other games thus far. Blight is getting deadlier, and gnarlier too. Our programmers are working all sorts of technical magic to make Blighted shine, ooze and wriggle. And every new object in the game is another opportunity for our artists to draw up a fresh nightmarish creation to populate the growing world. And Jim Guthrie is still sending us tracks that put shivers down our spines in all of the best ways.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdS_wktGXW5cZQpDDjZt3wW6YyMfT8JOuDx3nTPCVZ09bmpu-1zeVOE7mKbCfz3RxLrI_0weblRZDYIhxJnt5lL6L0ZvElUxzM4LaMA6zo8hz-WDj0LxC1uAYI-FOXRAFfLqGL8vg?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're also prepping the soundtrack from Tales from Space: Mutant Blobs Attack to be released on Steam very soon! As one of our first major releases, Mutant Blobs Attack will always hold a special place in our ears - because the soundtrack by Peter Chapman and Shaun Hatton is SO GOOD. If you ever need a shot of caffeine directly into your earlobes, load up this soundtrack, sit back, and get back up again because your toes will not stop tapping.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLSBqlew1oYLAN1HV9oezPGECMjlVP1r4NB60tS529tzdSypMl_0bJVfLRJZz_hjtCOLy1nLpgeY7kSNurU6ldRLcLNQ3oz2_pudPhbuFnB3ZoxyzqBpNN0xonYoR_d-smP7VDZQ?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]On the more human side, we recently took the team out to get their quarterly quota of exercise by running, jumping, dodging, ducking, dipping, diving, dodging, throwing, shooting (basketball), shooting (gun) and yelling with [url="http://playactivate.com"][u]Activate[/u][/url]. We then gathered for our biggest team photo to date!! (we’re still missing an international co-worker or two, but we’ll get them one day!)[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGWP9bjPXc4TEF92lcb1cSn1rR7NMcd0_by5CbjprrIM9GQYpW25AntKL0Bb19xy4CZGFkhEORf8QcQ8pXc_6JxiaBuTCzExVvUUCiAWpYA4fbJlkbls86-kz4bFPP_1RkQSmY?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Huh. Turns out we have in fact been ‘up to much’! Sorry for all the yapping. As a thank you for listening, we’ve put [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/drinkbox/list/48544"][u]all of our games[/u][/url] on sale on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Catch you later![/p][p]The Drinkbox Team[/p]

notes.title: Announcing our new game: Blighted
notes.content: [p]Hello hello! We have some very exciting news to share!  We'd like to introduce you to [url="https://www.drinkboxstudios.com/games/blighted"]Blighted[/url], a Metroidvania Action-RPG set in a psychedelic western nightmare world, and our most ambitious project to date! [/p][p] Blighted features some of the most intense combat Drinkbox has ever put together, and for the first time in 3D! Time your attacks, read your enemies and capitalize on powerful finishers to survive deadly encounters. Punches will not be pulled!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/b91051b436a2ff35fc887775bb49c7a3be72dd21.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're also excited to debut what we're calling the [i]Blight[/i] system. Tracking skillful plays, the Blight system responds by ratcheting up the difficulty. At higher levels of Blight, enemy behaviors, player abilities and the surrounding environment can all change.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/c9561984667d1dc1ee4c410e45aebed3b78d80b5.gif"][/img][/p][p]Consume the brains of defeated bosses to reclaim lost memories and learn ethereal abilities. Use your newfound powers to complete special challenges and uncover hidden paths.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/466cccfd877be46c7ecf340e8b183e17805cd71a.gif"][/img][/p][p]Featuring music by the acclaimed composer [url="https://jimguthrie.bandcamp.com/"]Jim Guthrie[/url] (who also worked with us on [i]Nobody Saves the World[/i]), jam along to hauntingly beautiful tracks as you play solo, or in co-op!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/0e3a67165c01a154425f158063acb3c727eeebad.gif"][/img][/p][p]Wishlist the game to get notified when the game launches. Wishlisting also helps boost our Steam launch visibility, so is doubly appreciated.  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Finally, please consider [url="https://discord.gg/XXXtbjvx7j"]joining our Discord[/url] to keep up with news and updates about Blighted. Or to just hop in to say hi :)  Thank you all for your support. We can't wait to reveal more about the game soon!  All the best, The Drinkbox Team  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/2cbac35e7efd9c884b9fee3beb6b4858b2510b2f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DrinkBox Studios 2020 Year in Review
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Holidays! [/h1]

Wow… 2020 sure was a year, huh? 😅 Despite, well you know *gestures broadly*, we’re very fortunate to have had a pretty good year at DrinkBox and wanted to take some time to look back, reflect on the year, and share some highlights.

When COVID-19 hit back in March, the city of Toronto went into full lockdown and the whole DrinkBox team transitioned to working remotely from home. There was definitely an adjustment period as we set up our respective home offices, switched to using Discord for our daily stand ups and meetings, and got used to our new co-workers -- ie. our cats and dogs and plants, who were especially excited about this working-from-home we were all doing. We’ve since settled into a nice flow with the whole team working together remotely, and now we have a new Friday night ritual of playing games together via Discord, which is a nice thing to come out of this whole lockdown thing.

Speaking of which, here are some of our team’s favourite games they played in 2020:

[list]
[*] Cass: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/418530/Spelunky_2/]Spelunky 2[/url]
[*] Gabby: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/]Hades[/url]
[*] Graham: Crosscode
[*] Ian: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/601150/Devil_May_Cry_5/]Devil May Cry 5[/url]
[*] Josh: Rocket League

notes.title: Guacamelee! 2 - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Late last year, we announced that Guacamelee! 2 would be released… “soon-ish.” Well, soon-ish has almost arrived at Drinkbox Studios!

We’re thrilled to announce that Guacamelee! 2 will launch for Steam on August 21st for $19.99 USD. Check out the new launch trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Y5n_oHsR9Q

The original Guacamelee! launched in April of 2013. It’s now over five years later and the game still stands as the definitive Mexican-Folklore-Inspired-Luchador-Platform-Brawler-Metroidvania! How do we top that?

[h1]More Chicken![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/e107c62c6b90164fd67dcd57167919b726454549.jpg[/img]

The power of the pollo reigns supreme throughout Guacamelee! 2.

Small tunnel to traverse? Turn into a chicken and strut right on through.

Giant purple block in your way? Pollo Shot and smash that bad boy to bits.

Wait… what’s that? An orange block? Smash it with an expertly executed Pollo Slide.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/1d115387a9491c838d13afc0e874e5725b4d9ac1.png[/img]

Pollo Shot against bouncy walls and ricochet yourself a rapid path to freedom.

Experience the full glory of Pollo Glide by using air currents to reach unprecedented heights!

But what if the entire fabric of the Mexiverse is at risk of collapsing in on itself? No problem. Stumble upon a secret society of prophetic chickens and prove your worth. Could JUAN be the fabled CHICKEN-MAN!?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/0bce691e898948f37c3687e96601b54c29aee385.jpg[/img]

As you can well imagine, these new chicken moves aren’t just for busting your way into exotic new locations. Pollo combat is frantic, furious and fabulous.

In fact, there’s so much new chicken gameplay and content in Guacamelee! 2 that we embedded a genre-busting Pollovania completely inside of the main story’s Metroidvania. The only such game in existence as of the writing of this post… probably.

[h1]How to Train Your Luchador[/h1]

As we were making Guacamelee! 2, it occurred to us that all of the new abilities we were adding would require extensive training for players to properly master. So, we recruited a batch of mostly competent and somewhat knowledgeable characters to fill the role.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/e0b17ea3f222934b6541b50cf8c0f812995cba4f.jpg[/img]

As players progress through the world of Guacamelee! 2, they’ll encounter ability trainers. Each of these trainers has a specialty that they focus on. Complete trainer challenges and they’ll hook you up with powerful upgrades and cool new abilities.

Climb to the peak of fitness with Doña Chamoya or sharpen your beak under the tutelage of Rooster Ramírez. Upgrade your grappling moves with Coscorrona or decipher Uay Coco’s instructions to punch with explosive force!

However, if you really want to fight with finesse, visit Flame Face in one of his many tequila bar franchises and go toe-to-toe against punching Poncho (don’t hold back, he’s paid well for the job).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/d3c50b146d9885652f28744bc7b945d750cb4804.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Bigger Game than Ever Before[/h1]

Guacamelee! 2 is an epic adventure that can be experienced alone or co-operatively with three of your closest amigos. Explore hundreds of new platforming and combat challenges. New abilities such as Eagle Boost, Rocket Kick, GOOOTCHA! and more add to Juan’s awesome arsenal of luchador moves. Upgrade your pollo form with Pollo Shot, Pollo Slide and a plethora of new chicken abilities (some secret, some not so secret). Select strategically from dozens of new skill upgrades to maximize your lucha potential.

So how did we plan to squeeze all of this into a game the size of Guacamelee! ? We didn’t! Thanks to our poor planning, we were forced to create a much larger game than the original. You can expect a bigger, badder world, with all sorts of interesting nooks and crannies to explore and conquer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/3dcb382dad20f883d276f4d660c1fc8a46072f13.jpg[/img]

We’ve worked extremely hard on the game over the past two years, and we’re super hyped that people will finally be able to experience Guacamelee! 2 so soon. Please feel free to ask any questions you have in the comments below, and we will try to answer them the best we can!

Oh... and please Wishlist us! (if you wish)

This is… odd. Guacamelee! 2 has been announced for PC/Steam at PAX. But also, this game was announced for PC last year? So it was unannounced and re-announced, and along the way it became a PlayStation 4 exclusive. And now it isn’t. Guys, we’re trying to run a news website here and you’re making my life a living hell. Stop Press-lighting me. To sum up: the game is absolutely coming to PC now (and probably other platforms) but it looks great and honestly I just would rather be playing it than talking about when and where I might be playing it in the future.

notes.title: The 14 Best Metroidvania Games On PC
notes.content:
The Metroidvania is perhaps one of the more tricky genres to nail down. With its very name coming from an amalgamation of two actually quite different Nintendo-based game series – Metroid and Castlevania – quite what qualifies is always up for debate. Hence, we suspect this could be one of the more controversial lists, when it leaves out a favourite game that someone else might argue fits the remit, but we decided did not. The important thing to remember is that we re right. And all of these games are brilliant.

notes.title: Multiplayer Fixes! New DrinkBox workshop skins!! Sale!!!
notes.content:
Hey there Steam,
We’d like to tell you about a long-brewing update we’ve just put up that provides a few minor fixes, plus a dab of bonus content. Feast your eyes on the sumptuous changelist below:

[list][*]Enhancements to the costume creator: Instead of custom skins always changing appearance to Juan/Tostada while in Intenso mode, you can now specify whether they Intenso-fy as J/T or just as a gleaming version of the custom skin. You can also turn off the glow that appears around them while in the opposite dimension, which is handy if the skin has changed your character’s silhouette so that it wouldn't match the normal glow shape.
[*]Players who had an issue where their computer would run the game super-too-fast should hopefully now find that to be resolved. Please email us at support AT drinkboxstudios DOT com if you still see anything similar cropping up post-patch.
[*]Some changes to better support the new 3- and 4-player mode, as well as miscellaneous other bug fixes. For more detail, see the  [url=http://drinkboxstudios.com/changelists/stce_pc_changelist_2016-04-18.html]full changelist[/url]
[*]And the fun part: play as your favourite NPC! We’ve added to the Workshop for both Guac STCE and Gold Edition custom skins to let you play as X’Tabay, Uay Chivo, Flameface or Jaguar Javier. Steam user Mujizik worked with us to create these lavishly animated reskins, and they’re free to download as of today.[/list]

Finally, we’re having a sale! Guacamelee (STCE, Gold and the Complete bundle) will be 80% off on Steam for the next week! Tell all your Guac-deprived friends. :juan:
